result.summary: The home screen shows a broken delivery-fee value and a truncated restaurant name in the Fastest near you row.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows the delivery fee as '€NaN delivery', indicating a failed or missing numeric value.
issues.suggestion: Guard against null/undefined fees and format a real amount or a fallback such as 'Free' or a dash instead of NaN.

issues.description: The third restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word under its card.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines or use an ellipsis so the full name remains readable.
